title: Ray's Materials
description: A port of my Ray's Dongles containing all the materials & armor
body:
Hey all! This is the 2nd mini port from Ray's Dongles. This contains all of the materials, & armor from Ray's Dongles, into a separate mod. 

This adds the Enderdust, Ruby, & Topaz ores into world generation. It adds armor sets for Ruby & Topaz. If you use this mod along side Ray's Utilities, you can also get Ruby & Topaz tool variants! Make sure to use Ray's Utilities 1.0.1 OR higher. Version 1.0.0 will NOT check for Ray's Materials, because this mod wasn't created until version 1.0.1 of Ray's Utilities.

Ray's Utilities now available on Curseforge & Modrinth!
Ray's Agriculture now available on Curseforge & Modrinth!
